scripts.lint:ui-primitives: eslint --no-ignore src/components/ui/AhvInput.tsx src/components/ui/EmailInput.tsx src/components/ui/IbanInput.tsx src/components/ui/PhoneInput.tsx src/components/ui/PhotoPicker.tsx src/components/ui/PostalCodeInput.tsx src/components/ui/TeamPicker.tsx src/components/ui/dialCodes.ts src/components/ui/__tests__
scripts.db:verify-pv:dev: ssh hetzner "sudo docker exec -i kscw-postgres psql -U supabase_admin -d directus_kscw_dev -tA -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c \"SELECT kind||' '||participation||' '||viewer_user FROM verify_participation_visibility()\"" | (! grep .) && echo '✓ participation_visibility: no drift (dev)'
scripts.db:verify-pv:prod: ssh hetzner "sudo docker exec -i kscw-postgres psql -U supabase_admin -d postgres -tA -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c \"SELECT kind||' '||participation||' '||viewer_user FROM verify_participation_visibility()\"" | (! grep .) && echo '✓ participation_visibility: no drift (prod)'
scripts.backup:deploy-scripts: rsync -avz directus/scripts/vps/ hetzner:/tmp/kscw-vps-scripts/ && ssh hetzner "sudo install -m 0755 -o root -g root /tmp/kscw-vps-scripts/*.sh /usr/local/bin/ && rm -rf /tmp/kscw-vps-scripts"
scripts.db:deploy:dev: npm run db:snapshot:dev && npm run db:migrate:dev && npm run db:setup-perms:dev && npm run db:smoke:dev
scripts.db:deploy:prod: npm run db:snapshot:prod && npm run db:migrate:prod && npm run db:setup-perms:prod && npm run db:smoke:prod
scripts.db:fresh-install:dev: cat directus/scripts/SCHEMA.sql | ssh hetzner 'sudo docker exec -i kscw-postgres psql -U supabase_admin -d directus_kscw_dev -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1' && npm run db:migrate:dev && npm run db:setup-perms:dev && npm run db:smoke:dev
scripts.db:fresh-install:PROD-DANGER: cat directus/scripts/SCHEMA.sql | ssh hetzner 'sudo docker exec -i kscw-postgres psql -U supabase_admin -d postgres -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1' && npm run db:migrate:prod && npm run db:setup-perms:prod && npm run db:smoke:prod
scripts.db:clubdesk:diff:dev: ssh hetzner 'sudo docker exec -i kscw-postgres psql -U supabase_admin -d directus_kscw_dev -X' < directus/scripts/clubdesk-diff-queries.sql
scripts.db:clubdesk:diff:prod: ssh hetzner 'sudo docker exec -i kscw-postgres psql -U supabase_admin -d postgres -X' < directus/scripts/clubdesk-diff-queries.sql
scripts.db:iban:backfill:dev: ssh hetzner 'sudo docker exec -i kscw-postgres psql -U supabase_admin -d directus_kscw_dev -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1' < directus/scripts/backfill-member-iban.sql
scripts.db:iban:backfill:prod: ssh hetzner 'sudo docker exec -i kscw-postgres psql -U supabase_admin -d postgres -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1' < directus/scripts/backfill-member-iban.sql
scripts.ext:deploy: npm run ext:deploy:dev && npm run ext:deploy:prod
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run db:deploy:dev && npm run ext:deploy:dev
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run db:deploy:prod && npm run ext:deploy:prod
scripts.scripts:deploy:dev: rsync -avz --delete directus/scripts/ hetzner:/tmp/kscw-scripts/ && ssh hetzner "sudo rsync -a --delete --include='[0-9][0-9][0-9]-*' --exclude='*' /tmp/kscw-scripts/ /opt/directus-kscw-dev/scripts/ && sudo rsync -a /tmp/kscw-scripts/ /opt/directus-kscw-dev/scripts/"
scripts.scripts:deploy:prod: rsync -avz --delete directus/scripts/ hetzner:/tmp/kscw-scripts/ && ssh hetzner "sudo rsync -a --delete --include='[0-9][0-9][0-9]-*' --exclude='*' /tmp/kscw-scripts/ /opt/directus-kscw/scripts/ && sudo rsync -a /tmp/kscw-scripts/ /opt/directus-kscw/scripts/"
scripts.scripts:deploy: npm run scripts:deploy:dev && npm run scripts:deploy:prod
scripts.clubdesk:deploy: rsync -avz directus/scripts/clubdesk-*.sh directus/scripts/clubdesk-*.mjs directus/scripts/import-clubdesk-*.mjs hetzner:/tmp/clubdesk-deploy/ && ssh hetzner "sudo cp -f /tmp/clubdesk-deploy/clubdesk-*.sh /tmp/clubdesk-deploy/clubdesk-*.mjs /tmp/clubdesk-deploy/import-clubdesk-*.mjs /opt/clubdesk-sync/ && sudo chmod +x /opt/clubdesk-sync/*.sh && ! sudo grep -lq supabase-db-vek42 /opt/clubdesk-sync/*.sh /opt/clubdesk-sync/*.mjs && echo '✓ clubdesk-sync scripts deployed (no stale container ref)'"
scripts.hallenfinder:sync:dev: node directus/scripts/hallenfinder-scrape.mjs --emit-sql | ssh hetzner 'sudo docker exec -i kscw-postgres psql -U supabase_admin -d directus_kscw_dev -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1'
scripts.hallenfinder:sync:prod: node directus/scripts/hallenfinder-scrape.mjs --emit-sql | ssh hetzner 'sudo docker exec -i kscw-postgres psql -U supabase_admin -d postgres -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1'
scripts.hallenfinder:deploy: rsync -avz directus/scripts/hallenfinder-scrape.mjs directus/scripts/hallenfinder-details.mjs directus/scripts/hallenfinder-sync.sh hetzner:/tmp/hallenfinder-deploy/ && rsync -avz directus/scripts/hallenfinder/ hetzner:/tmp/hallenfinder-deploy/hallenfinder/ && ssh hetzner "sudo mkdir -p /opt/hallenfinder-sync/hallenfinder && sudo cp -f /tmp/hallenfinder-deploy/hallenfinder-scrape.mjs /tmp/hallenfinder-deploy/hallenfinder-details.mjs /tmp/hallenfinder-deploy/hallenfinder-sync.sh /opt/hallenfinder-sync/ && sudo cp -f /tmp/hallenfinder-deploy/hallenfinder/*.mjs /opt/hallenfinder-sync/hallenfinder/ && sudo chmod +x /opt/hallenfinder-sync/hallenfinder-sync.sh && rm -rf /tmp/hallenfinder-deploy"
scripts.docs:graph: node docs/code-graph/extract-graph.mjs && node docs/code-graph/gen-layer1.mjs && node docs/code-graph/gen-html.mjs
